resolved_original_blocker.resolution: The new spec explicitly permits shape-only augmentation of the five existing synthetic metadata acceptance fixtures. Null is permitted for not_run/command_failed/output_bound_exceeded; consistent objects are permitted for ok/invalid_version. The sole old ok/captured_bytes=0 value may become the actual accepted version byte length. Existing expectations and all other old probe values are frozen. The former impossible combination must receive a new rejection control.

scope_contract_review.safe_report_surface: Only exact prefix/tail labels, bounded counts and five fixed Boolean flags; no raw or arbitrary strings, captures, paths, environment contents, byte codes, hashes or secrets.
scope_contract_review.capture_unchanged: Same retained shell string, same pipeline argv/order and same refusal/version regex. Vendor prefix removal is permitted only for a local classification candidate, not the captured value or acceptance input.
scope_contract_review.relations_executable: Exact keys/types/enums and bounded counts; absent core/null tail/not_parsed, present core/allowed prefix/non-null tail, zero tail iff empty, empty prefix/zero bytes/all flags false, nonempty prefix/nonzero bytes; null iff not_run/command_failed/overflow, object iff ok/invalid_version. For ok the declared accepted-prefix/core/legacy-tail/32-byte/no-flags/version-byte-count relations can all be enforced without exposing the invalid captured string.
scope_contract_review.shell_feasibility: A locally scoped C-locale pure Bash classifier can inspect at most the existing retained cap, then return only fixed labels/counts/flags. No additional host query or ambient query locale change is needed. This is a design feasibility finding, not execution validation.
scope_contract_review.guard_and_bounds: Old four-key probe, shared query, regex, reason/outcome, versions and 5s/16384/16385 plus 150s/65536 boundaries remain frozen. New metadata consistency checks do not relax accepted version syntax.
scope_contract_review.old_test_edit_claim: Existing observability tests will change in the expressly adjudicated pins/stripping/five-fixture areas. A claim that no old diagnostic test changed would be false.
scope_contract_review.other_old_tests: Original 43 host controls and all other old tests/fixtures/assertions remain frozen. Existing positive/negative expectations, test count, caps, timeouts and rejection cases remain unchanged except the explicitly adjudicated single synthetic ok byte-count value.
scope_contract_review.workflow: All bytes outside the existing host report validator remain frozen.
scope_contract_review.forbidden_operations: No new queries, HOME restoration, fallback, install, config/DB/container mutation, worker push, GH production API, SSH or credential access.
